title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover a range of focused environments across Cedarville's campus, from silent library zones to glass-walled lakeside views.

cards.title: Silent Zone Desks
cards.subtitle: Centennial Library
cards.notes: Head to the lower level for the university's designated silent zone. It features individual study rooms and carrels for zero-distraction work.
cards.short_summary: The Centennial Library's lower level is the campus's primary silent study area, featuring individual carrels and private rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The lower level of the library is designated as a Silent Zone Area and includes individual study rooms.
cards.source_title: Q. Where are the talking zones and the quiet zones located? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; typically 7:45 AM to 11:30 PM on weekdays during the academic term.

cards.entity_name: Center for Biblical and Theological Studies
cards.title: Lakeside Glass Atrium
cards.subtitle: Center for Biblical and Theological Studies (BTS)
cards.notes: Secure a high table in the glass-walled atrium overlooking Cedar Lake. It is a bright, scenic spot for morning reading and quiet reflection.
cards.short_summary: The BTS building features a prominent glass front with high tables that offer views of the campus lake.
cards.evidence_claim: The BTS is described as a glass building overlooking the lake with high tables suitable for morning study.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Have Quiet Time on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; centrally located on campus near the lake.

cards.title: Upper SSC Group Tables
cards.subtitle: Stevens Student Center (SSC)
cards.notes: Use the large tables on the upper level for group projects. The high ceilings and evening atmosphere provide a focused yet collaborative vibe.
cards.short_summary: The upper level of the Stevens Student Center offers large tables designed for group study and collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The upper SSC tables are noted for having six chairs and a quieter vibe after dinner compared to the lower level.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: The SSC is a central hub; upper level tables are open to all students for group or individual use.

cards.title: Academic Enrichment Tables
cards.subtitle: Stevens Student Center (SSC)
cards.notes: Visit the university's academic enrichment center for a welcoming environment. It offers peer tutoring and specialized academic support services.
cards.short_summary: The Cove provides a dedicated space for academic support, including tutoring and disability services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cove is Cedarville's academic enrichment center offering peer tutoring and a welcoming study space.
cards.access_notes: Located within the Stevens Student Center; check for specific tutoring and office hours.

cards.entity_name: Engineering and Science Center Computer Lab
cards.title: ENS General-Use Lab
cards.subtitle: Engineering and Science Center (ENS)
cards.notes: Utilize the 40-station general-use computer lab for technical tasks. The building also features several lounges for casual study between labs.
cards.short_summary: The ENS building houses a 40-station computer lab and multiple lounges for science and engineering students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Engineering and Science Center contains a 40-station general-use computer laboratory and several lounges.
cards.access_notes: Open to students; features video and data connectivity in classrooms and labs.

cards.title: Reservable Group Rooms
cards.subtitle: Centennial Library
cards.notes: Book one of the nine group study rooms online for up to 3 hours. Each room includes a TV monitor for screen sharing and collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: Centennial Library offers nine reservable group study rooms equipped with monitors for student collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Group study rooms can be reserved for up to 3 hours and include TV monitors for plugging in devices.
cards.source_title: Q. How do I reserve a group study room? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Reservations are made through the LibCal system; rooms have varying capacities.

cards.title: Lower SSC Cafe Seating
cards.subtitle: Stevens Student Center (SSC)
cards.notes: Grab a coffee at Rinnova and find a tall table for light reading. This area is a popular spot for between-class study and social interaction.
cards.short_summary: The lower level of the SSC near Rinnova coffee shop provides tall tables for casual study and reading.
cards.evidence_claim: The area near Rinnova in the lower SSC is described as a favorite between-classes spot with tall tables.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during SSC hours; can be busy and loud during peak times.

cards.title: Music Practice Modules
cards.subtitle: Dixon Ministry Center (DMC)
cards.notes: Utilize one of the 20 practice rooms for focused music study. These modules are designed for individual instrumental or vocal practice.
cards.short_summary: The Dixon Ministry Center provides 20 practice rooms for music and worship students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dixon Ministry Center includes 20 practice rooms and four rehearsal halls for the Department of Music and Worship.
cards.source_title: Music and Worship Facilities | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Primarily for music students; located within the Bolthouse Center for Music.

cards.title: Athletic Team Meeting Space
cards.subtitle: Callan Athletic Center (CAL)
cards.notes: Use the 2,000-square-foot team room for reviewing film or group meetings. It is a modern space designed for student-athletes and staff.
cards.short_summary: The Callan Athletic Center expansion includes a large team room for meetings and film review.
cards.evidence_claim: The Callan expansion houses a 2,000-square-foot Athletic Team Room for staff and student-athletes to meet.
cards.access_notes: Located in the 2022 expansion; primarily serves athletic programs and allied health students.

cards.title: Upper Level Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Centennial Library
cards.notes: Find a desk near the windows on the upper level for a balance of natural light and quiet. This zone is ideal for focused individual study.
cards.short_summary: The upper level of the Centennial Library is a designated Quiet Zone with window-side seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The upstairs of the library is designated as a Quiet Zone Area.
cards.source_title: Q. Where are the talking zones and the quiet zones located? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; quieter than the main entrance level.
